assets.prompt:
Make a production ART DRAFT of a GRASS GROUND TILE SHEET matching the attached hand-inked storybook cartoon reference: muted sage/olive grassy planes, sparse simple blade marks, dark olive colored outlines only on exposed turf boundaries, flat two-tone shading. No realism, dense tiny leaves, low-poly rendering or pixel art. Reference image is STYLE ONLY. Do not recreate its buildings, characters, trees or composition.
Square canvas. Exactly 4 columns x4 rows, 16 separated equal-size square tile cells, aligned neatly on uniform opaque #00FF00 background with equal green gutters and outer margins. Ground-only top-down square tiles: NO CLIFF WALLS, NO ELEVATION, NO ROCKS. All tiles at same scale. Think cut portions of one continuous ground surface, NOT individual grass islands. Connecting sides cut perfectly straight to square boundary without dark outlines, decorations or shadows. Only exposed edges have grass fringes.
Row1: four alternative PLAIN BORDERLESS grass center squares, completely filled corner to corner, perfectly straight edges, NO frame, NO fringe, NO shading toward edges. Quiet sage-green background same value at all four sides with just a few sparse blades in interior.
Row2: straight north outer grass edge only; straight east outer edge only; straight south outer edge only; straight west outer edge only. All other sides are undecorated flat connecting cuts.
Row3: exterior convex northwest corner; northeast corner; southeast corner; southwest corner. Only two OUTER sides have fringe, other sides straight connecting cuts.
Row4: four INNER CONCAVE corner tiles, respectively small quarter-circle green cutout at northwest, northeast, southeast, southwest. Grass occupies rest of square. Only curved cutout has outlined turf edge. Keep corners small so it is NOT four large L-shaped isolated islands.
No labels, no text, paths, soil, flowers, props, UI, shadows on background, checkerboard, transparency or perspective tilt.

Create ONE CLIFF ELEVATION ART SHEET for a front-facing top-down 2.5D cartoon game. Match the reference hand-drawn colored-ink style: clear dark charcoal/olive outlines, simple muted taupe-grey natural stone shapes, flat two-tone colors and soft sage green turf. No photorealism, no pixel art, no low-poly or shiny 3D. Reference is style only; no buildings trees props characters.
Exactly 4 columns x3 rows =12 separated cliff pieces on a wide landscape canvas. Generous even pure GREEN gutters and margins. Same orthographic elevated front view, same light from upper left, same rock scale and turf thickness throughout. Each cliff is NATURAL ROCK, not built masonry; irregular fractured large stones with unequal sizes and seams, no rows of uniform bricks. Broad solid supporting faces, left and right sides flare outward not inward. Grass cap is a narrow plain surface transitioning via irregular turf lip, not bushes or a hedge.
Row1: full-height straight FRONT cliff wall variation A, full-height straight FRONT wall variation B with different rocks, full-height LEFT side wall segment, full-height RIGHT side wall segment. Side walls must clearly face outward and have substantial visible rock faces, not just edge-on slivers. Connecting ends straight and undecorated, no endcaps on straight segments.
Row2: front-left convex exterior cliff corner, front-right convex exterior corner, a concave interior cliff corner turning left, a concave interior cliff corner turning right. Make wall direction and top grass lip follow each turn consistently. No slopes or ramps.
Row3: HALF-height front wall; QUARTER-height front wall; HALF-height small standalone grass-topped step plateau; QUARTER-height small standalone grass-topped step plateau. Full wall height 120 design units, half 60, quarter 30. Keep equal widths for compared half/quarter walls and equal top footprints for compared half/quarter step plateaus so difference in WALL HEIGHT is obvious. Do NOT scale whole sprite to fake height changes.
Every piece fully visible, no overlaps. Pure solid opaque bright green #00FF00 background including all empty spaces. No shadows outside asset footprint. No labels, text, furniture, props, flowers, trees, stairs, paths, ramps, water, checkerboard or transparency. Art layout study; distinct pieces only, not a scene.
